name: Choice Controls
description: A styled checkbox, radio group, and toggle switch sharing one Sand & Surf design language, fully accessible with ARIA, keyboard support, and visible focus rings.
usage: import ChoiceControls, { Checkbox, RadioGroup, Radio, Toggle } from "@/components/ChoiceControls"; then render <Checkbox label="…" />, a <RadioGroup label="…"><Radio value="…" label="…" /></RadioGroup>, or <Toggle label="…" />.
